result:
These queries are untested: I could not run anything, and I wrote them from the documentation page alone. I made three assumptions the page does not confirm:
- `sum` of an empty vector answers 0 (S5).
- `at` on a null subject answers null (S6).
- Splitting `Dee,Sales,` on "," keeps the empty last field (S8).

S14 also assumes `sort` is stable, since cache1 and api1 tie on uptime.

S1: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | filter ~(/labels | any ~(lower | eq "bug")) | count
S2: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | filter ~(/assignee | ne null) | groupBy ~/assignee * count
S3: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | sort ~([(at :priority | coalesce 0 | desc) /id]) | take 3 * /id
S4: [/dependencies /devDependencies] * (entries | filter ~(/1 | startsWith "^") * (/0 | keyword)) | flat | distinct | sort
S5: * {:customer /customer :total (/items * (mulOf /qty /price) | sum)} | groupBy ~/customer * (* /total | sum) | entries * {:customer (/0 | keyword) :total (/1 | round 2)} | sort ~(/total | desc) | take 2
S6: /data/users | filter ~(at :profile | at :city | coalesce "" | lower | eq "berlin") * (/email | lower) | sort
S7: lines | filter ~(trim | count | gt 0) * (split " ") | filter ~(/1 | upper | eq "ERROR") | groupBy ~/2 * count
S8: lines | drop 1 | filter ~(trim | count | gt 0) * (split ",") | filter ~(/2 | count | gt 0) | groupBy ~(/1 | lower) * (* (/2 | parseJson) | avg | round 1)
S9: filter ~(/published) * (at :tags | coalesce [] | (* lower) | distinct) | flat | groupBy * count | entries * {:tag (/0 | keyword) :count /1} | sort ~([(/count | desc) /tag]) | take 3
S10: /services | filter ~(at :enabled | eq true) * (at :port)
S11: filter ~(at :stock | type | eq ::number) | filter ~(/stock | gt 0) * (/category | lower) | distinct | sort
S12: "The cat and the Hat and THE bat sat on a mat with the cat" | split " " * lower | groupBy * count | entries * {:word (/0 | keyword) :count /1} | sort ~([(/count | desc) /word]) | take 3
S13: groupBy ~/user | entries * {:user (/0 | keyword) :count (/1 | count) :first (/1 * /ts | min)} | sort ~/user
S14: lines | filter ~(trim | count | gt 0) | filter ~(startsWith "#" | not) * (split "|") | filter ~(/1 | lower | startsWith "eu-") | filter ~(/2 | ne "down") | sort ~(/3 | parseJson | desc) * /0 | join ","
